Assessment
Delores Ratke (DOB 1982-10-30, MRN SYN-2341997) is a 41-year-old female referred for a second opinion regarding left-sided tinnitus and low-frequency hearing loss prior to a scheduled left stapedotomy with prosthesis on 2024-06-24 at an outside surgery center (booked by outside otolaryngologist Dr. Desmond Fairweather-Oyelaran for a presumed diagnosis of left otosclerosis).

1. Clinical History & Symptoms:
- Left-sided low-pitched humming tinnitus since November 2023 and left aural fullness.
- Prominent autophony and bone-conduction hyperacusis: hears her own voice, chewing, footsteps, and gaze-evoked tinnitus (hears her eyes moving) inside the left ear.
- Vestibular symptoms: Tullio phenomenon (vertigo/oscillopsia where the room seems to jump for a few seconds triggered by loud sounds such as a smoke alarm or shouting) and Hennebert sign / pressure-induced vertigo (triggered by Valsalva/straining to lift a box).

2. Audiology Interpretation (2024-04-16 outside report):
- Right ear: Normal hearing (5-15 dB HL), no air-bone gap, WRS 100%.
